description_en: Executes a command on cloud phone instances
description_zh: 在云手机实例中执行命令
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic run-command --instance-ids acp-7b15ex960000 --command-content ls --timeout 60 --agent-type EdsAgent --content-encoding PlainText --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCommand

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs. A single request supports up to 50 instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID列表。一次请求最多支持50个实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The timeout period. Unit: seconds. If the command is not completed within this period, the command execution status is set to timeout. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 60 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间。单位秒，如果超过该时间命令仍然没有执行完成，则命令执行状态为超时，如果不填则默认为60秒
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The channel type used to execute the command
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en:
The encoding method of the command content (`CommandContent`). This parameter is case-insensitive.

If the specified value is not within the valid values, it is processed as `PlainText`
parameters.help_zh:
命令内容（`CommandContent`）的编码方式。不区分大小写。

若传入的值不在枚举值范围内，则一律视为`PlainText`处理
parameters.name: content_encoding

InvokeId.description_en: The command execution ID. You can use this ID to query the command execution result
InvokeId.description_zh: 命令执行ID，可以通过这个ID查询命令执行结果

RunCommandInfos.description_en: The list of command execution information for each cloud phone instance
RunCommandInfos.description_zh: 各云手机实例的命令执行信息列表

items.description_en: The command execution information for a single cloud phone instance
items.description_zh: 单个云手机实例的命令执行信息
